messages:
katherine: Quick all-hands micro-brief — please drop 1-line updates (yesterday / today / blockers) and any asks for cross-team help. I'll compile for the weekly leadership sync. Thanks :wave:

sam: Yesterday: landed autoscaler tuning for Dedicated pools. Today: running extended perf tests. Blocker: seeing a regression in 4k token streams under burst load, reproducer attached. @oliver can you take a quick look? :thinking_face:

oliver: On it. Can you paste the failing trace / command you used? Also looping in @eng-runtime for batching/kernel checks.

sam: repro snippet:
```
# run load test
./loadtest --model redwood-bleu --seq-len 4096 --concurrency 48 
--timeout 120
# observed: kv-cache OOM + 503s in stream
```

dev-bot: Deployment to staging completed: canary v2.3.1 -> 3 instances (hash: abc123) :rocket:

priyanka: Yesterday: docs PR for rollout policies merged. Today: prepping demo for partner call. Blocker: need sample latency/cost metrics from Redwood Optimize for last 7 days to include in slide deck — @mike any chance for quick extract?

mike: Yep, I'll run a query and post the JSON to #eng-platform in ~30m. If you need a particular workspace id ping me here.

carla: Heads up — I'll be OOO tomorrow afternoon (medical appt). No blockers from my side, leaving onboarding checklist updated.

katherine: Thanks — two asks: 1) If you haven't filled the weekly headcount & capacity form, please do by EOD. 2) Nominations for "Operational Hero" this sprint? I'll collate and surface in leadership notes.

sam: Nominate @oliver — great debugging on the autoscaler last week. :medal_sports:

oliver: thanks! team effort.

mike: Quick heads-up for finance: billing team requested per-project token breakdown for the enterprise pilot. @finance-bot can you open a ticket?

finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-482 and assigned to @helen.

helen: I'll take that. Will sync with @mike after lunch and confirm required columns.

james: Add to agenda: short demo of prefetch caching improvement (5 min) — pretty solid latency drop on p95.

katherine: Added to today's all-hands agenda. Final reminder: company all-hands at 4pm PT — we'll cover Dedicated roadmap highlights + a quick QA. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam: bumping my earlier request — tagging @eng-runtime again in case someone can spare 30m to triage the 4k stream repro.

oliver: I can carve out 30m at 10:45. Will bring logs and a minimal repro.

katherine: Perfect — I'll mark that as a follow-up action. If anyone else has cross-team asks, drop them here and I'll surface.
